items.title: Nakajima-extremal ordinary bielliptic Artin-Schreier curves with full dihedral-times-involution automorphism group
items.author: Saeed Tafazolian
items.difficulty_reason: The complete characteristic-two construction produces an ordinary Artin-Schreier cover from prescribed residues of an invariant elliptic differential, proves independence of the defining function, lifts the ordinary elliptic q-torsion translations and inversion, computes full automorphisms using bielliptic rigidity, and controls ramification/free cyclic quotients. All five original properties are one family-construction theorem, with q>=8 and all original field/differential/residue hypotheses preserved. Old tower proposition concerns later quotient families, not this full extremal construction. Converse/parameter/explicit-model results retained without separate counts.

primary.label: Complete original five-property extremal Artin-Schreier main construction theorem
